title: VIXEN build wrapper should preserve its paired Undertow root
body: The queued ./build-wsl.sh --target frame_targets_refresh -j8 retry failed because configure discarded the earlier context and Text required UNDERTOW_ROOT; env UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/pair-cx-rbs2r3 on every invocation worked. Carry the paired schema root through the preset or wrapper.

title: Historical VIXEN GPU attribution should expose the effective kernel pin
body: The round-2 Cornell binary used a hidden per-build-tree VIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE=9347e2ebd9ba01803500061005ff92093a44ee81; reproducing the exact tuple and historical matrices required manually setting cache overrides. Emit the effective pin into capture evidence and provide a supported attribution flag.

title: GPU transfer generation must reject unresolved runtime-state CLR layouts
body: A settings type declared in the global namespace while schemas.json named Vixen.Codegen.Gpu.LightingSettings made GaiaGpuScheduleModule silently emit class=hot and regions=[]; manual manifest inspection found it. Fail generation when a transfer kind CLR type cannot resolve, naming the kind and CLR name.

title: Exposure histogram needs a declarative hand-stage resource identity
body: ExposureMeter.comp writes only the trailing histogram buffer and ExposureReduce.comp consumes it, while state:exposure-meter exposes only four scalar state members. Wildcard footprints produce SCHED004 and no honest existing member orders the stages. Add a governed schema identity or pipe for this GPU-only histogram.

title: Pinned VIXEN CodegenTool builds should be warning-clean on Linux
body: The queued frame_targets_refresh rebuilt the pinned kernel CodegenTool with 26 NETSDK1188 warnings for zh-hans and zh-hant resources in Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp 4.8.0. Normalize or update the package/toolchain so a required regeneration does not violate the zero-warning witness.

title: SPT propose usage must document mandatory tier and effort tags
body: The worker-rule sample command with category and consolidation tags failed first for a missing tier tag and then for a missing effort tag. Document both required tag classes in the canonical sample so lanes do not need failed retries.
